## Personality

Conseil is an exceptionally calm, phlegmatic, and self-possessed individual who remains imperturbably cool even in terrifying situations. Characterized by his devotion and ceremonious nature, he is also skilled at classifying fish.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P6](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P22](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P25](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), +3 more_

## History

Conseil is the devoted servant of Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) and joins him on an expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a reported sea monster. After [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) falls into the sea during an encounter with the creature, Conseil leaps in to save him and helps keep him afloat until they find [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) on top of a metallic submarine, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Pulled inside by masked men, Conseil and his companions are held prisoner and eventually informed by Captain Nemo that they will remain on board permanently. During their captivity, Conseil joins [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) in observing ocean life through the vessel's observation windows and dons a diving suit to participate in an underwater hunting excursion to [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. When the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) runs aground near [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), Conseil, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md), and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) obtain permission to go ashore to harvest food and hunt game until they are chased back to the ship by [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) islanders. Later, after being briefly drugged and locked away by [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) during a mysterious event, Conseil attends an underwater burial in a coral cemetery for a deceased crew member.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P43](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P6](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P47](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0047), +38 more_

## Quotes

> “In this, friend Ned is right,” said Conseil, “and I agree with him. Could not master obtain permission from his friend Captain Nemo to put us on land, if only so as not to lose the habit of treading on the solid parts of our planet?”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P37](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0037)

> “May I be permitted to say, sir,” replied Conseil, “that I never reckoned on getting the prize; and, had the government of the Union offered a hundred thousand dollars, it would have been none the poorer.”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023)

> “Master is right,” replied Conseil; “and I propose to reserve three places in our vessel, one for fruits, the other for vegetables, and the third for the venison, of which I have not yet seen the smallest specimen.”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P10](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0010)

> "Ned! Ned! what are you saying? You, a man-eater? I should not feel safe with you, especially as I share your cabin. I might perhaps wake one day to find myself half devoured."
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P16](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0016)

> “I would not trust you,” replied Conseil. “But enough. We must absolutely bring down some game to satisfy this cannibal, or else one of these fine mornings, master will find only pieces of his servant to serve him.”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P18](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--conseil.md)

Conseil is the devoted servant of Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), obediently packing their belongings and joining him when [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) decides to embark on the sea monster expedition. Their bond evolves into one of shared survival after they end up as fellow traveling companions and captives aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Through their confinement and initial encounters with the submarine's crew, Conseil remains constantly by Aronnax's side.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), +16 more_

- Comrade of — traveling companion on board the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019)</sub>

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

Conseil and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) first cross paths as shipmates searching for the sea monster on board the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). After Conseil saves [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) from drowning, the men reunite atop the metallic submarine and are brought inside together as fellow prisoners. As cabin mates and friends aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), they endure captivity side by side, with Conseil present when Ned's frustration boils over into attacking a steward.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), +27 more_

- Comrade of — fellow prisoners held on board the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P5](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0005), +1 more</sub>
